description: Erection of single storey rear and side extension at ground level,  rear dormer extension and front roof lights.
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">maintenance plan (where applicable) of the water butt with overflow and rain garden shall be </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. It must be demonstrated </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">reduction in peak flow rate and volume.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-0f487ecc-7fff-5d24-1e9e-fc6a6e043f40"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">REASON: To reduce the risks from surface water flooding</span></span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;"></span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-797ce300-7fff-bc4a-dbfa-0e4b89864d89"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</span></p>
